_comment: C# models: ASP.NET Core (MVC, Razor Pages, minimal APIs), ASP.NET MVC/WebForms, ADO.NET, EF/EF Core, Dapper, NHibernate, OrmLite, MongoDB driver, System.Diagnostics, serializers, Roslyn scripting, HttpClient/WebClient, System.DirectoryServices, System.Xml.XPath.

sinks.label: shell command
sinks.title: Tainted data reaches Process.Start
sinks.title_ar: بيانات غير موثوقة تصل إلى Process.Start
sinks.advice: لا تبنِ الأمر من المدخلات؛ ثبّت FileName ومرّر Arguments بعد تحقق.

sinks.label: SQL

sinks.label: file path

sinks.label: filesystem operation
